description: This file defines an OpikLogger class for integrating with the Opik analytics and tracing system. It includes methods for logging trace and span events, both synchronously and asynchronously, and manages connection setup, batching, and external API communication. The class is designed for flexible configuration and integration with external Opik client components.

classes.name: OpikLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending LLM event data to an Opik server, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with batching and external client integration.
